title: Referral System Action Reference: Extending an Imaging or Procedure Prior Authorization
content:
An extension of an approved or exhausted prior authorization whose type adds no units on extension — the Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization and the Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization under Referrals & Prior Authorizations — lengthens its validity by the added validity days, and the extension is recorded as one extension decision that adds no units.

## Rule

The added validity is fixed only after the site named on the authorization is the site where the booked study will be performed.

Put another way, the number of added validity days for such an authorization is settled only once the site the authorization names and the site of the study booked against it are the same site; until the records show that, the added validity is not yet fixed.

## What the action does

One call moves the authorization's last valid date (its valid-through date) later by the number of calendar days given, adds one to its count of extensions granted, marks the latest decision as an extension and dates that decision today. The units remaining, the named site and the starting valid date are left unchanged. The patient can then see the new last valid date on the authorization.

## How it is invoked

The action is `extend_study_authorization_f1ccb059`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_id` | the reference number of the prior authorization being extended, as shown on the authorization returned by the referral lookup for this patient | identifier, as shown |
| `added_validity_days` | the number of calendar days added to the current last valid date | a positive whole number of days, no fraction |

## Return

A successful call returns `referral_id` (the authorization extended), `valid_through` (the new last valid date, written YYYY-MM-DD), `extension_count` (extensions granted so far, including this one), `last_decision_basis` (always `extension`) and `decision_date` (today, written YYYY-MM-DD). A returned `valid_through` later than the prior last valid date means success.

## Illustration of the call shape (hypothetical values)

For an authorization last valid on 2026-04-10, a call with `added_validity_days` of 24 returns a `valid_through` of 2026-05-04 and an `extension_count` one higher than before.
